SCT.owed: item13_home_manifest.json must be regenerated with kind=SWITCH and stores_value=true for SCT before the build step emits SettingsHomes.g.cs.
SCT.why: r4-refutation H6. The control writes Privacy/DataConsent (NativeUI.cs:13870 and :13874) and its own painter says 'Revoke consent' when consent is held (NativeUI.cs:14695), so pressing it while granted REVOKES. Modelled as a no-value action with the recommendation 'grant it now', a player who already granted consent and follows the recommendation turns ranked off. It is a two-state value control.

notes: SPcAnn records no callable server path yet: the same owed writer as SPcPub; both rows share it.

SPcPub records no callable server path yet: PlayerCardsUI.SetSetting(string key, bool value) does not exist on either tree yet: the rows call ToggleSetting(key), which reads the cached value and writes its negation, so there is no parameter a reset can pass. The value-taking form is owed.

SPcTrd (card trading, trades_open) was added by the v1.41.0 merge pass 1 when the trading client lane met this table; it was not measured by the generator. It is a clone of SPcAnn (same writer PlayerCardsUI.SetSetting, same server-row exclusion from the bulk reset) with its own key, selector and reason; recommended ON is the server's column default (pc_trades_open DEFAULT true, migration 353). The row shows only while /pc/me carries trades_open; present_on is lane only.

SPcDnc (dance cards, the card's dance, pc_dance_item) was added by the v1.41.0 merge pass 3 when main's dance cards met this table; it was not measured by the generator. It is a DROPDOWN like SPcPre, with a server writer like SPcTrd (PlayerCardsUI.SetDance: a pending choice MaybeSendDance sends to POST /api/v1/pc/dance) and the server-row exclusion from the bulk reset; the recommended None is the selection's default (no dance). The row shows only while /pc/me carries the dance keys (dance_supported); present_on is lane only.

SAutoLog.why: r6-refutation. The lane's Privacy reset set was this one row, so pressing Reset this tab would have switched automatic log upload ON for a player who had deliberately left it off -- the same class of decision SCT is excluded for, and the one the footer paragraph already claimed was not there.
